why: Intro to the terminal plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-terminal.json), 'Permissions and chmod' (passes: private.txt has mode 600, read and write for the owner only). The learner set it symbolically (`chmod u=rw,go= private.txt`, the same 600) and checked it with `stat -f '%Lp %N'` instead of `ls -l`: '600 private.txt'. The mode is right; there is just no '-rw-------' column on screen. Done.

step.title: Lock down private.txt
step.instructions: Make private.txt readable and writable by you only with chmod 600 private.txt. Check it with ls -l private.txt: the line should start with -rw-------.

checks.label: ls -l shows read and write for the owner only
